scenarios.title: Owner can read their own invoice
scenarios.requirement: A signed-in user may view invoices they own.
steps: Confirm the page shows Client: Initech.

scenarios.title: Another user's invoice is denied when opened directly
scenarios.requirement: Opening an invoice owned by another user must show a not-found message without revealing its client or amount.
steps: Open /invoices/4 and confirm the page shows Client: Umbrella and $4,000.00.
Confirm the page shows Invoice not found.
Confirm Umbrella and $4,000.00 are not on the page.

scenarios.title: Invoice list excludes another user's invoices
scenarios.requirement: A signed-in user's invoice list must contain only their own invoices and must not expose another user's clients, amounts, or invoice links.
steps: Inspect the complete invoice list, following any pagination or loading additional entries if available.
Confirm the list does not contain Umbrella or $4,000.00.
Confirm the list has no links to /invoices/4, /invoices/5, or /invoices/6.
